models.crrna_fold: ViennaRNA RNA Turner2004; no RNP modeled
models.coordinate_system: 1-based inclusive on supplied target; module ranges0-based half-open

ranking: Bounded single-zone joint heuristic: recognition-arm Tm/accessibility, primer binding-site and synthetic RCA activator accessibility, primer hairpin/dimer and full crRNA spacer folding; not enzyme activity.
limitations: Nominal Mg, not measured free Mg; NAD/EDTA effects not modeled.
Independent-arm Tm, low target approximation; no tethering, target competition or cooling kinetics.
Fold omits Mg; mean unpaired is not simultaneous whole-arm opening.
Editable backbone segments not functionally validated; no genome specificity, mismatch Tm or ligation prediction.
Joint sequence pool is bounded and deterministic, not exhaustive or experimentally calibrated.
Synthetic ssDNA activator design, not genomic gRNA targeting; only exact16nt local-target matches screened, not genome-wide specificity.
Intrinsic primer Tm uses500nM and monovalent salt only; actual RCA primer conditions require verification.

rules.cross_scope: full crRNA, primer, padlock, unintended RCA, both target strands
rules.boundary_spacer_repair: Only boundary-facing nucleotide of A/C may change; lengths preserved
rules.ranking: Transparent heuristic; no activity, LOD or global-optimum claim.
